description: How Borderlands 2 guns shoot, read from the game by Run-ShootingSurvey.bat (GD_Weap_*.A_Weapons weapon types, FiringModes). Speeds are Borderlands units per second; the generator converts them. Per-manufacturer values differ (clip size 5-48, spread 1.0-8.0); these are the common defaults.

columns.speed_bl2: projectile speed in Borderlands units/s (FiringModeDefinition.Speed; launchers: the rocket's ProjectileDefinition.SpeedFormula, 2600-5200 by manufacturer, 3000 typical)
columns.clip: WeaponTypeDefinition.ClipSize of the Bandit weapon type
columns.explosive: yes when every shot explodes (launcher rockets); elemental guns of any type use Default_Elemental_Explosions
columns.burst: rounds fired per trigger pull for automatic guns (placeholder: Skyrim cannot read a held trigger without the script extender, so automatic fire is a burst of this many rounds at fire_interval)
columns.explosion_radius: explosion radius in Skyrim units (placeholder until the rocket and elemental explosion definitions are surveyed)
